newsitem.title: BOSNIA: TABLE - Bosnia July output down 10.6 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Bosnia July output down 10.6 pct m/m.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Friday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION JULY JUNE JULY 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Herzegovina. No data are available for the country's Serb entity, which covers the remaining 49 percent. Bosnian industrial output is up 39.5 percent in Jan-July period compared to the same period in 1996, but July 1997 production is down 85.5 percent compared to the prewar July 1991 output, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
